name: Falling Star (Combat, Technique)
body:
Your descent comes before a strike like a meteor’s impact.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 4 ranks, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): As you fall from a higher position, you can make a single attack as a standard action against one creature within your reach as you descend. This attack can be made from a space above a creature. The attack deals double damage. Provided you can control your descent or voluntarily jumped you may instead choose to charge a creature for the same effect. In the case of other abilities that double damage (such as the Spirited Charge feat) remember that two doublings equal a tripling and so forth.
